description: This file defines the Memcached class used for caching in the system. It provides methods to get, set, and delete cache entries using the Memcached extension. The class encapsulates the Memcached object and manages cache expiration settings.

classes.name: Memcached
classes.description: A class that wraps the PHP Memcached extension to provide caching functionalities such as get, set, and delete operations with configurable expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcached object and adds a server with specified hostname and port, setting the default expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key, prepending it with a prefix.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache under the specified key with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry identified by the key.
